French prosecutors have moved Apple toward trial over alleged planned obsolescence linked to older iPhone performance and repair practices. headlines.title: GTA VI: Why the 13-year wait could be worth $8 billion
headlines.snippet: After more than 13 years, Grand Theft Auto VI finally launches on November 19, and it's about a lot more than a video game. Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian follows the money: why Take-Two is telling investors to expect $8 billion-plus in bookings this year but only about $109 million to $142 million in profit, how GTA Online's recurring spending became the real prize, and why Sony and Microsoft can cash in without making the game at all.
